Krea is coming to London! 

(This time for architects)

We're doing a one-night pop-up at Shreeji's. There will be four rooms that take you through how architects work with Krea.

We'll take a single sketch through to a 3D model, then develop the design live in Krea Real-time. We'll also show where AI agents can take on parts of your workflow.

After that, it will be your turn with the tools, with time to talk it through with us.

Space is very limited - RSVP here: https://lnkd.in/ejRGUPJE 

When: Wednesday, October 28, 5:30pm
Where: Shreeji Newsagents, 6 Chiltern Street, London
